title: Aureline M5 retirement review packet
description: Canonical per-domain retirement review packet for a retiring M5 line, capability, bundle, command / deep link, schema-bearing surface, registry-visible package, or managed / new-tenant feature. It is the typed proof that must be completed before a line or stable-facing surface can move to Retired: it joins the migration outcome summary, the final compatibility / public-proof join, the exact-build snapshot refs, the support-note closure status (help, support KBs, partner notes, procurement FAQs, and incident / runbook references marked updated, archived, redirected, or intentionally closed), the archival signoff refs, and any unresolved dependent blockers to one candidate identity. Support, help, and public-proof surfaces point at this schema so they read the closure state directly from the packet instead of relying on free-text release notes. The migration outcome, support-note closure status, and archival refs are mandatory; a packet missing any of them can never mark the candidate ready for final retirement. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
